name: VATIKAN
description: Vatikan is a Russian Rummy variant using double deck + 2 jokers (106 cards). 2-5 players, 13 each. Key feature: players can REARRANGE existing melds on the table to integrate new cards. First meld must be a sequence from hand. Jokers are wild but can't be moved between melds directly. Draw OR meld each turn (not both).

content.text: Vatikan is a Russian Rummy variant using double deck + 2 jokers (106 cards). 2-5 players, 13 each. Key feature: players can REARRANGE existing melds on the table to integrate new cards. First meld must be a sequence from hand. Jokers are wild but can't be moved between melds directly. Draw OR meld each turn (not both).

Vatikan is described in Andrew Pennycook's A Book of Card Games and is said to be of Central European origin. It belongs to the manipulation rummy family, in which players may rearrange melds on the table; it is very similar to the Italian game Machiavelli and related to Carousel. The tile game Rummikub is a close relative played with tiles rather than cards.
106 cards (2x52 + 2 jokers). A can be high or low.
13 cards each. Remaining cards form the stock; there is no discard pile.

items.text: Standard: Standard Vatikan as described: double pack with two jokers, 13 cards each, draw or meld per turn, first meld sequence of three in suit.
